commits.message:
fix(strip): Strip measures as the row it draws (rich-strip-hbbu) (#328)

* fix(strip): Strip measures as the row it draws (rich-strip-hbbu)

Strip implemented Renderable only, so Measurement.get answered (0, maxWidth)
for it and every container measuring one got the whole offer. It now sums its
items' measurements and the cells its joins draw; render and measure read one
list of joins. effects-feel's drawn-row workaround is replaced by Measurement.get.

* fix(strip): a strip's width is both its bounds, and its row takes no justify (rich-strip-hbbu)

Review of #328: summing the items' minimums promised a narrower strip
the walk never draws, so a Table squeezed the column and cropped the
last items. measure now reads the drawn row; the row clears the justify
its container hands it, which padded the first item over the rest.

* docs(claude): strip stays in core tier 4; it no longer imports measure (rich-strip-hbbu)

effects-feel: light and wind keep their pace however wide the row (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Review (medium): shimmer and drift crossed the whole span once a period, so a
wider row moved faster — shimmer 0.046 and drift 0.056 per frame at 160-240
columns, over the 0.04 bar. Both now move STRIDE (80) columns a period: the
text line's old pace, the strip slower. Worst hourly step is width-independent
(shimmer 0.031, drift 0.029). drift no longer takes span. A firefly's stroke
scales with its brightness, so dim flashes no longer streak fastest. The step
gate now watches a 240-column element too.

effects-feel: a firefly drifts as fast as it is bright; tests run the demo's breath (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Review (high): a dark turn divided by zero in the glide; it now keeps its
length and gives no light. HOP named beside GLIDE; order() builds no closure
per cell; the step-gate comment states the measured 0.039.

effects-feel: breath blooms then rests, glints read as passes, fireflies draw a lit stroke, transitions linger in tendrils (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Pulse turn 43 s with the breath's seconds unchanged, so the bloom from the
heart can visibly spread (REACH 0.3) and the element rests between breaths.
Shimmer band 24 columns either side, so each pass reads as a pass. Fireflies
drift up to 5 cells while lit. Fade 20 s, dissolve 30 s, ordered by
domain-warped noise. Every loop still under the 1 fps step gate over an hour
(worst: pulse 0.039, shimmer 0.036, drift 0.035, sparkle 0.032).
